text: Accepts `username = "@bakeshop:<username-or-email>"` (preferred) or bare module credentials. - Looks up `bakeshop_users` by username **or** email, verifies `password_hash` with `password_verify`, and rejects users whose password equals the legacy bootstrap hash or the reset marker. - Returns an identity payload with `id`, `username`, `email`, `full_name`, `role`, `source = 'bakeshop'`, and `token_version`.
